      - text: May 9, 2026·Camoufox Engine Architecture What is Camoufox Camoufox is a Firefox fork that patches the browser's C++ implementation to spoof fingerprinting properties. Unlike traditional anti-detection solutions that inject JavaScript to override browser APIs, Camoufox modifies the underlying C++ code that implements these APIs, making the spoofed values indistinguishable from genuine browser behavior.
